entities.name: The Scarab God
entities.description: One of three gods captured and distorted by Nicol Bolas; leader of the Eternals and a member of the Chitin Court.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon planeswalker who captured and warped the gods to serve him.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: Event during which Bolas captured the gods.

entities.name: Hashaton
entities.description: Served the Scarab God before it was warped.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Undead soldiers the Scarab God led, converted from Amonkhet's creatures.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God who rebuilt the Hekma and used her flaming spear against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City where the Scarab God was confined outside and where the Phyrexians were fought.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Plane targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: Another insect god, part of the Chitin Court.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Led elite fighters to dismember the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: Name for the Scarab and Locust Gods, who collect undead followers.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Amonkhet was a target.

events.summary: Hazoret rebuilds the Hekma and the Scarab God is confined outside Naktamun.
events.quote: When Hazoret rebuilt the Hekma , the Scarab God was confined outside Naktamun .

events.summary: The survivors find the Scarab and Locust Gods already at Naktamun fighting the Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders

events.summary: Hazoret ignites the oil in the Phyrexians' veins and Djeru's fighters dismember them.
events.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

events.summary: The insect gods depart for the deep desert without a word.
events.quote: the inscrutable insect gods departed for the deep desert without a word

events.summary: After the God-Pharaoh's death the Scarab and Locust Gods show agency, deeming themselves the true gods and forming the Chitin Court.
events.quote: They saw themselves as the true gods of the plane

relations.note: Captured and distorted it to serve his interests.
relations.quote: captured and distorted by Nicol Bolas to serve his interests

relations.note: Served it before it was warped.
relations.quote: Hashaton served the Scarab God before the god was warped by Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Its function was to lead the Eternals.
relations.quote: to lead the Eternals during the Hour of Eternity
the Chitin Court , as they are termed, collects more undead followers
